meta.name: Send Florida insurance and legal news digest with GPT-4o-mini and Outlook

parameters.content:
## N8N-AIS-Florida Insurance Digest

### How it works

1. The workflow is triggered on a schedule. 
2. It fetches RSS feeds and normalizes the data. 
3. Filters out articles that have already been seen. 
4. Uses AI to analyze batches of new articles.
5. Builds an HTML newsletter and sends it to valid email subscribers. 
6. Updates the seen hashes with information on sent articles.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure RSS feed URLs in the 'Fetch' nodes.
- [ ] Set up access credentials for SharePoint and Microsoft Excel nodes for seen hashes handling.
- [ ] Ensure Microsoft Outlook node is configured for sending emails.
- [ ] Configure AI settings in the 'Basic LLM Chain' node.

### Customization

Adjust RSS feed URLs and the AI model settings to tune the types of articles processed and the analysis details.

## Initial setup and trigger

Starts workflow on schedule and loads seen article hashes.

## Prepare seen set

Builds a set of seen hashes for fast lookup.

## Fetch RSS feeds

Fetches articles from different RSS sources.

## Normalize article data

Applies custom code to normalize fetched article data.

## Merge articles

Merges all normalized articles into a single batch.

## Filter and check relevance

Drops already seen articles and filters relevant ones.

## Batch processing

Splits articles into batches and processes them using AI.

## Build and send newsletter

Builds HTML newsletter and sends it out.

## Update seen hashes

Appends hashes of sent articles to the seen set.
